mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies and a comfortable 81 degrees out by the Verona Area High School.

The city is busy with updates this week. Mayor Diaz has proclaimed September 2026 as Hunger Action Month to combat local food insecurity, and please note that there will be traffic flagging on Highway M on August 31 and September 1 for utility work.

We have a packed schedule today, including the Verona Area Kids Triathlon, Girls Try Hockey at the ice arena, and live music at both Baileys Run and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga tomorrow at Insight Wellness and trivia at the Hop Haus on September 1.
The police department has been busy, and looking back to August 17, officers successfully located and arrested a 21-year-old man on Cross Country Road for a probation violation.
The flavor of the day is the delicious Crazy for Cookie Dough, and since the restaurant is open until 10 PM tonight, head on over and enjoy a scoop while you can.
